name: BRC Group Holdings, Inc. - Depositary Shares, each representing a 1/1000th fractional interest in a share of Series A Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock
summary: BRC Group Holdings is a diversified holding company that operates through several segments, including financial services, telecom, and retail. Its core financial services platform provides investment banking, brokerage, wealth management, asset management, and business advisory services. The company serves public and private companies, financial sponsors, and individual clients primarily in North America.
